title: JSFL: timeline.setActiveLayer() method missing
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the JsflTimeline interface and proxy (~lines 685-746, 472-473) do NOT have a setActiveLayer(layerIndex) method. The timeline.currentLayer property is writable (line 472-473), which is the workaround. Fix: add setActiveLayer(layerIndex: number): void to the JsflTimeline interface and proxy implementation, as a one-line wrapper that sets this.currentLayer = layerIndex (or equivalent in the proxy context). This provides Flash 8 API compatibility for JSFL scripts that call tl.setActiveLayer(n).
